summary: AIM ImmunoTech Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a routine amendment to an existing promissory note with Streeterville Capital LLC. The amendment extends the maturity from June 30, 2026 to June 30, 2027, adds a $10,000 extension fee to the outstanding balance of $1,682,676.16, and contains customary representations. No change in principal amount, conversion rights, or new financing is involved. This is a standard debt modification, not a special situation. The 8-K also includes results of operations disclosure and a press release. What to watch: None; purely administrative.
